title: The Seagull and the Kite
summary: A greedy seagull caught a giant sea-fish and tried to swallow it whole. The fish was so enormous that it lodged in the gull's throat, choking him to death upon the sandy beach....
full_text:
A greedy seagull caught a giant sea-fish and tried to swallow it whole. The fish was so enormous that it lodged in the gull's throat, choking him to death upon the sandy beach.

A kite flying overhead saw the lifeless bird and remarked:

"You have met your deserved fate, bird of the sea! With a belly made for sprats, you attempted to swallow the ocean whole!"
moral: Greed that attempts to swallow more than nature can hold chokes upon its prize.
